summary: Russian forces conducted missile strikes on Kyiv and Engels, Russia, resulting in casualties and explosions. Ukrainian officials announced the appointment of Serhiy Korytsky as Prime Minister and the dismissal of Defense Minister Oleksiy Reznikov. Protests emerged in Kyiv against Reznikov's removal, while EU officials sought explanations regarding the defense minister changes.
key_points: Russian missile strikes on Kyiv killed two civilians and wounded five, including a child, according to Ukrainian officials. (Source: @UkraineNow/82709)
Explosions occurred in Engels, Russia, where drones reportedly struck residential buildings and a military airfield. (Source: @UkraineNow/82680)
Serhiy Korytsky was appointed Prime Minister by the Ukrainian parliament, with a platform focusing on defense preparedness and economic stability. (Source: @UkraineNow/82692)
Defense Minister Oleksiy Reznikov resigned, stating it was an honor to serve the Ukrainian people. (Source: @UkraineNow/82684)
Protests took place in Kyiv, Lviv, and Dnepropetrovsk against the dismissal of Defense Minister Fedorov. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31662)
The EU requested explanations from Zelensky regarding Fedorov's dismissal, noting close cooperation on defense matters. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31671)
Russia advanced toward several Ukrainian positions in Sloviansk, according to Russian officials. (Source: @tass_agency/385592)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces continue aggressive operations across multiple fronts, with increased drone and missile activity targeting Ukrainian population centers and military infrastructure. The resignation of Defense Minister Reznikov and subsequent protests indicate internal political instability that could affect operational coordination. Ukrainian forces maintain effective asymmetric warfare capabilities, particularly with AI-enhanced drone systems that reportedly reduce Russian casualty survival times. The situation remains volatile with potential for escalation in eastern and southern directions.
sections.regional_response: European Union officials expressed concern over the rapid changes in Ukrainian military leadership, requesting explanations from President Zelensky regarding Defense Minister Fedorov's dismissal. The EU highlighted its close cooperation with Fedorov on defense matters, including drone strike operations. Protests emerged in multiple Ukrainian cities against the leadership changes, indicating public scrutiny of governmental decisions during the ongoing conflict.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian officials reported record procurement of 50,000 ground robotic complexes this year, representing a significant increase from previous contracts. Russian tactical aviation activity has been detected on multiple fronts, threatening rear areas in northeastern directions. Exchange operations for deceased servicemen continue, with Ukraine receiving 501 bodies and Russia receiving 31. Russian stock market indicators showed significant decline, with the MOEX index falling below 2100 points for the first time since December 2022.
